Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000831": As of 2025-12-01, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000373": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: authentication gateway, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000495" [decision]: As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000836": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)
- memory_id "1001177" [decision]: The job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a follow-up decision from the INC-2026-009 review.  (about: job scheduler, INC-2026-009, the scheduler leader lease)

- memory_id "1000979": Team Dune noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the product catalog's owners.  (about: team Dune, product catalog, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000869" [decision]: The Boreal team adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Boreal team, weekly dependency update day)
- memory_id "1000896": Team Dune observed that the event-bus' request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: team Dune, the bus, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000762": The Boreal team observed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service, the traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000845": From 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not team Dune.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000451": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1001014" [decision]: On 2026-02-11, the Ember team handed feature-flags over to the Atlas team, not team Dune; team Dune never owned feature-flags.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, team Dune, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
